CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 15
   D. 10

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

3. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 72
   D. 17

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

5. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

6. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 20

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

10. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

13. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

14. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

15. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 7

16. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
